items.question: What is RediShop?
items.answer: RediShop is a sales app that connects sellers to products from major brands. The seller gets their own store, offers for their clients, commission on every sale and an AI that shows what to sell, to whom and when.

items.question: Is RediShop just another affiliate program?
items.answer: No. Besides selling products and earning commission, you get your own RediShop, organize your clients and count on an AI that finds selling opportunities every day.

items.question: Do I need to be an influencer to sell on RediShop?
items.answer: No. RediShop is for anyone who sells, recommends products or has relationships with clients.

items.question: Do I need to pay to use RediShop or buy a kit?
items.answer: No. RediShop is free for sellers. You don't need to invest anything or buy products to start.

items.question: Do I need to buy products before selling?
items.answer: No. You choose what you want to sell without buying any merchandise first.

items.question: Why would my client buy from me instead of directly from the brand?
items.answer: Because in your RediShop your client finds the product at least 5% cheaper than on the brand's official online store.

items.question: Who does my client pay?
items.answer: The brand directly, on its official online store.

items.question: Who delivers the product to my client?
items.answer: The brand itself handles the order and delivery.

items.question: How is my commission calculated?
items.answer: Redi automatically tracks everything you sell through your RediShop and calculates how much you're owed.

items.question: How does the money get to me?
items.answer: You register your bank account in the app. Redi collects the commission from the brand and, once received, transfers the amount to you.

items.question: Can I choose what I want to sell?
items.answer: Yes. You choose the brands and products you want to add to your RediShop.

items.question: Do the clients I win stay mine?
items.answer: Yes. You build your own client base and follow their purchase history in the app.

items.question: Where can I sell?
items.answer: Wherever your clients are: WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, live streams, social media or in person.

items.question: Does my credit history matter to sell on RediShop?
items.answer: Redi doesn't check or analyze your credit or ID status. To receive your commissions, you just need to register a bank account in your own name.
